# What the packaging builds from, one line per source: name, git URL, commit. The RPM and DEB build
# actions read this file, so a pin moves in one place. Bump the debian/changelog of the dependency
# with it (actions/deb-deps/<name>/changelog): a published version is never rebuilt with new bytes.
